title: Kenyan Crunchy Tomato Salad
description: A refreshing and crunchy salad originating from Kenya, perfect for a light meal or snack.

ingredients.name: Crunchy carrots
ingredients.notes: Shredded or grated for added crunch

ingredients.name: Diced tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Fresh and juicy for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Mixed greens salad
ingredients.notes: Fresh and crisp for the base of the salad

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens salad and diced tomatoes.
2. Top the salad with shredded carrots and sliced hard-cooked eggs.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together your favorite salad dressing ingredients.
4. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
